items.name: Sioux City Sunday 2023
items.information: This competition will be held alongside [Sioux Falls Saturday](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SiouxFallsSaturday2023) on the preceding day. You can compete in one or both of the competitions! We also have two local Facebook groups for our Cubing Area. Feel free to join the [Minnesota Cubing Community](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1798123093777480/) and [Iowa Cubing](https://www.facebook.com/groups/1629559883761917/) for information and announcements on upcoming competitions. This competition is supported by the [Midwest Cubing Association.](https://www.midwestcubing.org/) ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBbHN0IiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--50185814dd3aca6d46fbfd751cf63a2aa0a3739b/image.png)

items.name: Studio 21 Open Sunday 2023

venue.name: Studio 21
venue.address: 04/05, second floor, Pacific D21 Mall, Dwarka, Delhi, 110077

items.information: # **NOTE: This event comprises two separate competitions, the other one is on Saturday. Please note that each participant can only compete on one of the two days.** Participants have to bring their own cube for the event. Check out all the other Tabs for more detailed information. * Make sure you will be available at the venue at least 15 minutes before your event starts. You won't be allowed to participate in an event under any circumstances if you reach late. * If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time or not aware of competition rules, make sure that you attend the tutorial session. * If you're participating in a WCA competition for first time, please bring your goverment ID card for verification. * All the participants are requested to volunteer in the competition and every participant (except newcomers) will be assigned to a particular event they have to either judge, scramble, etc for the group/event.
